Snapdragon Miso Ramen Cup is a 2.2 oz single-serve instant ramen featuring a miso-based broth with soy and fermented soybean flavor for a traditional Japanese-style taste. Each cup contains air-dried noodles with a chewy texture, a seasoning packet, a dried vegetable packet, and a flavoring oil packet that are added in stages during preparation. To prepare by kettle, open the lid halfway, remove the packets, add the vegetable and seasoning packets, fill with hot water to the marked fill line, close the lid, and wait 3 minutes before stirring in the flavoring oil. To prepare by microwave, remove the packets, add the vegetable and seasoning packets, fill with cool water to the fill line, and microwave on high for 2 minutes; let cool for 1 minute before adding the flavoring oil and stirring. Microwave cook times may vary depending on oven wattage. Do not microwave without water, and handle the cup with care since contents will be hot after cooking. This ramen cup is suited for quick meals or snacks at home, at the office, or while traveling. Store unopened cups in a cool, dry place until ready to prepare.
